# Delivery Gallery: review guide

Status: draft for review; not an installed skill.

## Outcome

A searchable gallery page generated from curated example configuration.

Reader: People and agents deciding what to hand over

## Procedure

### 1. Choose a kind

Filter by Skill, Page or Drawing.

### 2. Inspect a result

See the real preview, intended reader, and files.

### 3. Open the product

Open the usable example or its original material.

### 4. Reuse its structure

Export the example configuration and adapt it.

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] Each example points to existing material.
- [ ] Search and filters produce readable results and an empty state.
- [ ] The preview identifies a prototype honestly.
- [ ] The source configuration rebuilds the same page.

Should file formats be filters or attributes of a single delivery?
